rows.source: PDG2026; exact synthetic masses; Decimal80 oracle

rows.limit: Specified frame and initial momentum; no impulse dynamics.

rows.limit: Stationary target; labelled two-body products; fixed masses.

rows.name: Momentum balance

rows.limit: Floating-point closure; not an experimental confidence test.

rows.case: m=4,1 elastic; T=3; lab0; supplied values1,1 mb/sr
